conventional long form.text: Territory of the Wallis and Futuna Islands

local long form.text: Territoire des Iles Wallis et Futuna

former.text: Hoorn Islands is the former name of the Futuna Islands

etymology.text: Wallis Island is named after British Captain Samuel WALLIS, who visited in 1767; Futuna is a local name, and the meaning is unclear

Government type.text: parliamentary democracy (Territorial Assembly); overseas collectivity of France

time difference.text: UTC+12 (17 hours ahead of Washington, DC, during Standard Time)

Languages.text: Wallisian (indigenous Polynesian language) 58.9%, Futunian 30.1%, French (official) 10.8%, other 0.2% (2003 est.)
